topic: Sound, Heat, Electrical, and Light Energy
key_concepts: Sound energy is produced by vibrating objects.
Sound travels through a medium such as air, solids, or liquids.
Fast vibrations produce high pitch; slow vibrations produce low pitch.
Sound travels fastest in solids because molecules are close together.
Infrasonic and ultrasonic sounds are beyond human hearing range.
Sonar uses ultrasonic sound to locate objects underwater.
Heat is energy transferred from hotter to colder objects.
Heat transfers by conduction, convection, and radiation.
Electrical energy is the movement of electrons through a conductor.
A closed circuit distributes electrical energy to loads that convert it to other forms.
Light energy travels in waves and is produced by chemical reactions or electricity.
